# @tansy/theme-halo

A news front page for the blog plugin: an editor-curated lead story, recommended and trending picks, readers' choice and a popular carousel, on quiet panels.

```bash
npm install @tansy/theme-halo
```

Add it to `tansy.config.ts`. See [the halo theme documentation](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy/blob/main/docs/themes/halo.md) for what it adds and the options it takes.

A first-party theme for [tansy](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy), a self-hosted, runtime-schema CMS for Next.js. MIT licensed.
